title: Tray with std::move
hints: `items_.push_back(item);` does not compile. Read the error from the bottom up: it ends in "call to deleted constructor of `std::unique_ptr`". `push_back` is trying to *copy* a type that forbids copying.
`items_.push_back(std::move(item));` — `item` is a named variable inside `put`, so it is an lvalue even though the caller moved it in. The cast is what selects the move overload.
